mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sale (sale_no, partner_id, company_info_id, sale_date, total_amount, status, memo, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{saleNo}, #{partnerId}, #{companyInfoId}, #{saleDate}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, #{memo}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, sale_no, partner_id, company_info_id, sale_date, total_amount, status, memo, created_by, created_at, canceled_at FROM sale WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, sale_no, partner_id, company_info_id, sale_date, total_amount, status, memo, created_by, created_at, canceled_at FROM sale ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
